scenario: Beginner, sprint, 3 days, 45 min, race in about 9 weeks (taper)

workouts.title: Easy Swim technique
workouts.description: Focus on smooth breathing and relaxing your shoulders while swimming at a gentle conversational pace.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take today completely off to let your body recover and absorb the training stress from the week.

workouts.title: Easy Spin
workouts.description: Ride your bike at an easy, steady cadence to build your aerobic fitness without straining your legs.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to keep your energy high and prepare your muscles for the upcoming run session.

workouts.title: Easy Jog
workouts.description: Keep a very slow conversational pace, taking walking breaks if needed to protect your joints.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy a rest day to stretch gently and keep your mind relaxed over the weekend.

workouts.title: Active Rest
workouts.description: Take a light walk or completely rest to finish your first successful week of training.

workouts.title: Swim Endurance

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to let your swimming muscles recover and prepare for cycling.

workouts.title: Moderate Ride
workouts.description: Ride at a comfortable, steady effort that makes you breathe a little faster than normal.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a day off to stretch and relax before your running workout.

workouts.title: Steady Run
workouts.description: Run at a steady, comfortable pace without pushing yourself too hard.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to recover your legs for the weekend.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy a completely restful Sunday to wrap up week two.

workouts.title: Swim Practice
workouts.description: Practice smooth freestyle swimming with short rests between lengths to build confidence.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take today off to let your upper body recover from the swim workout.

workouts.title: Hill Prep Ride
workouts.description: Cycle at a moderate effort on rolling terrain to build leg strength and endurance.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to keep your muscles fresh for running.

workouts.description: Alternate between fast running and easy jogging to improve your speed and lung capacity safely.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to let your running legs recover fully.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a relaxing rest day before starting week four.

workouts.title: Recovery Swim

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy an easy rest day during your recovery week.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to help your body adapt to the training load.

workouts.title: Short Easy Run

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest on Saturday to prepare for next week's build phase.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take Sunday completely off to finish your recovery week feeling refreshed.

workouts.title: Swim Distance

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to let your arms and shoulders recover from the swim.

workouts.title: Longer Bike Ride

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.title: Steady Endurance Run

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy a peaceful Sunday rest day to close out week five.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to let your upper body recover from hard swim intervals.

workouts.title: Steady Bike Ride

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a rest day to keep your legs fresh for the brick workout.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Relax and enjoy your Sunday rest day.

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy a peaceful Sunday to conclude week seven.

workouts.title: Rest Day

workouts.description: Take today off to stretch and relax.
